ModMetaData.name: Categorized Cleaning - Split
ModMetaData.author: PeteTimesSix
ModMetaData.description:
Splits the cleaning work type into four:
One for clean rooms (kitchens, hospitals and laboratories) One for indoor cleaning One for a custom cleaning zone you paint yourself (Architect > Zone) One for outdoor cleaning in the home area
Each can be individually prioritized. A new "Cleaning" tab at the bottom of the screen lists every room on the map in one lane per column, placed automatically by room type (bedrooms are named after their owners); move a room between lanes to pin it to a column. The mod settings decide which room types land in which lane by default, and you can also pin a room by selecting a colonist and right-clicking inside it.
